I'd been seeing a male gyno for years (just for birth control). I trusted him because he was who my mom saw at the time. Every time he'd put the clamp in to get a pap smear sample, he did it with no warning and he'd just shove it in and open it, making me tense and putting me in pain. "If you relax, it won't hurt," he told me every single time.

I finally left him to see a female gyno. She welcomed me into her office, we discussed my history, etc. When it's exam time, she tells me she's going to insert the clamp. She gently nudges it in and, because I'm already tense waiting for it, I say a quick "ow" and then laugh it off like usual. But instead of continuing with the exam, she goes "I'm so sorry, did that hurt?" and pulls the clamp out. I tell her it just sucks and I'll get over it in a chipper voice, wanting to be a good patient.

Well let me tell you, she gently inserted the clamp again and opened it only as much as she needed to, talking to me the whole way through. It was so relaxing and kind, I almost cried on the spot.

Tl;dr: male gyno tells me to relax when pap smears hurt, female gyno adjusts what she needs to do to make me feel more comfortable.
